items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: The first record date we recorded two sides... Teddy Wilson and Red Norvel... And Harry James and myself.

ctx.x: How many sides did you record --
The first record date we recorded two sides. It was 'Just A Mood,' blues in two parts, one and two. As I stated before, Teddy Wilson and Red Norvel -- and I'll
make a correction on the instrument, he was playing xylophone, not vibraphones. Xylophone is wood. That's what he was playing at that time. And Harry James and myself.
